response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong software development skills and a diverse background across multiple domains, but his experience lacks depth in the core C++ and industrial automation requirements of the role. His expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, and full-stack development is impressive but not directly aligned with the job's focus on high-performance C++ systems, secure engineering, and industrial cybersecurity. However, his open-source contributions and problem-solving mindset could translate well to the role with targeted upskilling.
strengths: Extensive experience in full-stack development and modern software engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, agile methodologies).
Strong open-source contributions and leadership in event-driven architectures (e.g., GISCollective platform).
Diverse technical background with exposure to low-latency systems, multi-threading, and distributed systems.
concerns: Limited recent hands-on experience with C++ (last notable C++ role was in 2014–2015 at National Instruments).
No explicit mention of industrial cybersecurity, IEC 62443, or Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) practices.
Primary expertise lies in web/mobile development (TypeScript, Node.js, React) rather than on-premises/cloud industrial automation solutions.
